g.text: How in the ever-loving bloody hell did you convince *Quincy* of all people to speak to me on your behalf?
I just needed to apologize to you, and didn't know how else to do it.
I have no clue what you're talking about. [End.]
I... just didn't know how else to tell you I had feelings for you.
Points for the surprise factor, I suppose. I certainly wasn't expecting that. And... very well. Apology accepted.
I do have to admit you've been on my mind a great deal lately.
You did have a shot with me, and you chose to walk away. But... Quincy was convincing. If you'd like to give this another go, I'm willing to give it a try.
How about walking up to me in the Hub, and simply saying, 'mate, I have feelings for you?' Did that ever cross your mind?
If you'd like to give this a go, I'm willing to give it a try.
...Has anyone ever told you, you are *proper* nuts?
Sometimes I simply do not know what to do with you.
Well. Glad to have all that sorted then. Shall we?
Well. No point in fussing about it now. I... have to admit you've been on my mind. If you'd like to give this a go, I'm willing to give it a try.
